sudoReview.initialIssue: Sudo password and shell script must not share a stream that could interpret the password when auth is cached or NOPASSWD.
sudoReview.resolution: Constant wrapper consumes password separately; private temporary script excludes NAS password; sudo gets only password pipe; root script stdin redirected to /dev/null.
sudoReview.qtsTimestampValidationAlternative: sudo -v then -n was unsuitable on this QTS; no production deployment used that alternative.

binaryPreparation.diagnostic: NAS base64 decoder returns1 with final newline and0 without newline; captured minimal public samples
binaryPreparation.resolution: Remove CR/LF from encoded stream, then decode and require exact archive and executable SHA256 before use.

ordinarySshPreflight.initialPrivateHostKeyFileUnavailableToOp: Resolved by using the tracked original NAS public pin, without disabling verification.
ordinarySshPreflight.paramikoNotInstalled: Used system OpenSSH and private askpass socket; no global package installation.
